title: Data and machine learning
description: Python with uv mounted in, PyPI and Hugging Face open, more memory; the GPU if you give one.

de.title: Daten und maschinelles Lernen
de.description: Python mit uv eingehängt, PyPI und Hugging Face offen, mehr Speicher; die GPU, wenn Sie eine angeben.

notes: A current Python (3.14) with pip and uv comes with the preset (--toolchain python): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox); install into a virtual environment (uv venv, python3 -m venv). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add python: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.

The GPU, if given: dri (Intel/AMD, /dev/dri), rocm (AMD, /dev/kfd and /dev/dri) or nvidia (Podman with a CDI specification: sudo nvidia-ctk cdi generate --output=/etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml). A GPU weakens the isolation; the security modes high and paranoid refuse it.

CUDA or ROCm libraries come from an image variant of yours: sandbox-ai images new NAME --from AGENT, sandbox-ai images extend NAME --add-apt PKG / --add-pip PKG, then sandbox-ai build NAME; start with --image-variant NAME.
